content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) Section 9.2 now emphasizes the preference for using insulin analogs or inhaled insulin instead of injectable human insulin in most adults with type 1 diabetes. This recommendation is aimed at reducing the risk of hypoglycemia. Additionally, the guidelines now advocate for the early implementation of continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) in adults with type 1 diabetes to improve glycemic management and outcomes. Furthermore, the recommendations have been expanded to include the use of any glucose-lowering agents that offer additional benefits, such as weight management, cardiometabolic improvements, or kidney protection, beyond their glucose-lowering effects.
